summary: Iteration 15 v1 store-ready strip-down tested. Backend: 208/209 pytest pass (target >=189 exceeded). All 6 new iteration-15 tests pass (DELETE /auth/me, report, block/unblock, self-report/self-block 400s, booking code format). Frontend: core happy-paths for customer & pro all working — no crashes, no dead ends. However 4 leftover subscription/AI/style-score UI surfaces remain visible on Home, Hairstyle Detail, Notifications and Pro Portfolio screens — iteration 15's 'strip-down' mandate not fully honored.

minor.issue: Legacy dormant test expects amara.plan_slug='braider_unlimited' but seed now returns 'braider_standard'. Since subscriptions are dormant in v1, either delete this obsolete assertion or fix seed.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Continue Dreaming' section still rendered on /home for returning users (uses /continue-dreaming/me endpoint). Iteration 15 explicitly requires 'No Continue Dreaming AI teasers.' The whole block (lines 176-202) must be removed.
Style Score badge in hero ('Style Score 94') and full 'Style Intelligence' card (lines 92-95 + 109-134) still visible. Iteration 15 mandates style-score is GONE from frontend.
Notifications screen shows a subscription/plan banner: 'You're now on Standard. Your Studio, portfolio, and...' — subscription UI should be stripped from v1.
Portfolio screen shows plan-cap copy: '6/5 photos — free plan cap.' — subscription/tier gating text should be removed (backend cap can remain dormant, but UI copy must go).

integration_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert() does NOT render on Expo web preview — the confirmation dialog (Cancel / Delete permanently) is invisible in the web build. This is a known Expo limitation and will work on iOS/Android native. Flag: cannot QA the destructive flow via web preview. Consider a custom Modal for web parity.

issues: Comment block at top of file (lines 8-19) still describes 4 tabs (Dashboard/Bookings/Growth/My Studio) but code now renders 3 (Schedule/Bookings/Profile). Update docstring.
